help.body:
This TUI is experimental and not recommended for anyone to use.

Navigation: 1-6 switch screens, arrows or hjkl move one row, Tab changes pane, / filters the active list, = cycles sorting, Backspace clears filtering, Esc returns to Backups.
Backups: n adds a game, b creates a snapshot, r restores, d deletes a snapshot, x deletes a game, e edits snapshot text, p sets current position.
Save Config: left pane selects a game, middle pane selects a save path, right pane shows device/path detail. n adds a game, a adds a save path, e edits the selected path, w renames the game, v scans configured VN directories.
Detect: i imports selected game, e edits the selected detected path before import, f switches local/all filtering, u updates the detection database, ! resets to bundled data.
Cloud: c checks backend, e edits backend, u uploads all, o downloads all, y syncs selected game, a syncs all enabled games, t toggles selected game cloud sync, r keeps local progress, p uses cloud progress.
Settings: Enter or t applies the selected setting, g imports a GUI profile into the TUI profile, n renames the current device, r adds a game root, v runs the VN scanner.
help.cloud_actions: c check, e edit backend, u upload all, o download all, y sync selected, a sync all, t toggle game sync, z cancel active operation, r keep local, p use cloud.
help.editor_actions: Left: choose game. Middle: choose save path. Right: choose device. n adds a game, a adds a path, e edits it, w renames the game, v scans VN directories.
help.ludusavi_actions: i imports selected. e edits highlighted path before import. f switches local/all filtering. u updates detection database. ! resets to bundled.
help.message: Enter or Esc closes this message. l opens logs.
help.prompt: Enter confirms. Esc cancels. Tab completes path variables or filesystem paths.
